app.name: AgroHub
app.tagline: Sell together. Get paid with confidence.

home.intro: Farmer cooperatives selling together, with payment held until delivery is confirmed.

roleSwitcher.label: Acting as
roleSwitcher.error: Could not switch role. Please try again.

signUp.title: Create your AgroHub account
signUp.consent: I have read and accept the <link>privacy notice</link>.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your address, then sign in.
signUp.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
signUp.passwordTooShort: Your password must be at least 8 characters.
signUp.consentRequired: Please accept the privacy notice to continue.
signUp.error: We could not create your account. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in to AgroHub
signIn.invalid: That email and password do not match.
signIn.unverified: Please verify your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
signIn.error: We could not sign you in. Please try again.

verified.title: Email verified
verified.body: Your email address is confirmed. You can now sign in.
verified.failedBody: The verification link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to get a new one.

twoFactor.enrolIntro: Your role needs a second step at sign-in. Confirm your password to get a setup key for your authenticator app.
twoFactor.setupInstructions: In your authenticator app, add an account with this setup key, or open the link on this phone.
twoFactor.backupCodesBody: Keep these somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone.
twoFactor.enrolConfirm: Enter the code your app shows to finish setup.
twoFactor.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for AgroHub.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Try the newest code.
twoFactor.expired: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
twoFactor.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please sign in again later.
twoFactor.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your cooperative
onboarding.intro: Tell us about your cooperative, then upload three documents so we can verify it.
onboarding.documentsIntro: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each.

status.incomplete: Upload all three documents to send your cooperative for review.
status.suspended: Your cooperative is suspended. Contact support.

errors.REGISTRATION_NUMBER_TAKEN: A cooperative with this registration number already exists.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the details and try again.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Upload a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
errors.FILE_TYPE_MISMATCH: That file does not look like a PDF, JPG or PNG.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is larger than 10 MB.
